TEST_1_first_sale_dashboard_updates.description: Added sale ($5000) → navigated to Dashboard via Home button → Sales donut immediately showed $5.0k. No logout/reload needed.
TEST_1_first_sale_dashboard_updates.evidence: Sales donut updated from $0 to $5.0k immediately after navigation

TEST_2_first_expense_dashboard_updates.description: Added raw material expense (V1, Chicken, qty=10, price=15, total=$150) → navigated to Dashboard → Spending donut showed $150 raw materials.

TEST_3_second_sale_totals_increase.description: Added second sale ($3000) → navigated to Dashboard → Sales donut showed $13.1k (previous $10.1k + $3000).

TEST_4_salary_dashboard_updates.description: Added salary (Chef, $2000) → navigated to Dashboard → Spending donut showed Salaries category with $2,000.00 (93%).
TEST_4_salary_dashboard_updates.evidence: Spending donut showed Salaries $2,000.00 (93%), Raw Materials $150.00 (7%)

TEST_5_navigation_no_stale_data.description: Navigated Dashboard → Sales → Dashboard → verified totals remained same (not stale or zero).
TEST_5_navigation_no_stale_data.evidence: Dashboard values persisted correctly after navigation

TEST_6_delete_dashboard_updates.description: Deleted raw material expense → navigated to Dashboard → Raw materials decreased to $0.00, Total spending decreased to $2.0k.
TEST_6_delete_dashboard_updates.evidence: Raw Materials went from $150.00 to $0.00, Total from $2.1k to $2.0k
